case: a title and a description in `self`, copied into the receipt
why: The shelf shows a title and a description for a stamped file, and before 04-10-2026 the stamp had neither: every reader fell back to the id or the file name. Both optional, both a courtesy. The receipt copies them beside the identity, and names the parents by identity only.
